description: This file defines a Lookup class for searching notes, notebooks, tags, reminders, trash items, and attachments within the Notesnook project. It includes methods for fuzzy search, regex search, highlighting, and content parsing, utilizing external libraries like 'fuzzyjs', 'kysely', and 'htmlparser2'.

classes.name: Lookup
classes.description: A class providing search functionalities for notes, notebooks, tags, reminders, trash items, and attachments within the Notesnook project.

methods.name: notes
methods.description: Performs a search for notes matching the query, returning IDs of matching notes.

methods.name: notesWithHighlighting
methods.description: Performs a search for notes with highlighted matching content, returning a virtualized grouping of highlighted results.

methods.name: notebooks
methods.description: Searches notebooks based on the query.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Searches tags based on the query.

methods.name: reminders
methods.description: Searches reminders based on the query.

methods.name: trash
methods.description: Provides search results for trash items, with sorting and item retrieval.

methods.name: attachments
methods.description: Searches attachments based on the query.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters items based on fuzzy matching with the query.

methods.name: toSearchResults
methods.description: Converts ID fetch functions into SearchResults interface.

methods.name: filterTrash
methods.description: Filters trash items based on relevance to the query.

methods.name: toVirtualizedGrouping
methods.description: Creates a virtualized grouping of items for efficient rendering.

methods.name: toItems
methods.description: Retrieves items by IDs with optional sorting.

methods.name: highlightQueries
methods.description: Highlights query terms within a text, returning the processed text and match status.

methods.name: splitHighlightedMatch
methods.description: Splits highlighted HTML content into match segments for display.

methods.name: splitToNearestWord
methods.description: Splits a string at the nearest word boundary within maxLength.

methods.name: centerMatch
methods.description: Centers a match within a given maximum length, adding ellipses as needed.

methods.name: stringToMatch
methods.description: Converts a string into a match array for highlighting.

methods.name: highlightHtmlContent
methods.description: Highlights query terms within HTML content, preserving structure.
